node.statement: The reset-constant ledger gives W.K3>=1 and W.K3>=W.L, and the structural-domain ledger applied to 0<=epsilon<=W.epsilon_MAIN gives epsilon<=W.e_cross/W.K3 and W.K3*epsilon<=W.K_call*epsilon<=W.r_reset. Since epsilon>=0, W.K3>=1 implies 0<=t_3:=W.K3*epsilon, and W.K3>=W.L implies epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon<=W.K3*epsilon=t_3. This proves all scalar bounds available before the target algebra is constructed; it deliberately does not infer 0<=epsilon_R from W.L alone.
